flavor_text.one_line: Brutal raider-soldiers bred from men and beasts, who live to slaughter for the war-spirit.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: Orcs are the archetypal beastman: war-bred from men and beasts by the long-dead sorcerers, and the most numerous of the made-races. They swarm from mountain warrens and wandering hordes under the totem of the Red Maw, the shaman (khashagh) feeding the skull-heap to Gul-Maraqus the War-Spirit. Always Chaotic, they raid, breed, and slaughter; their warlords carve brief domains from the ruin of better folk before the next horde devours them.
